svg.text: THE PROJECT AS A HEX MAP
One town, one temple, and fog to the east
Field Building turns evidence and working tools into a standard. What lies beyond the standard is a destination, not a plan.
each must pass the Standard's test
most of any map is empty.
Publish the standard: a public, versioned test,
free to use, that any bot can be checked against.
Adopters arrive on their own, or not at all.
Bards carry the word between towns; this book is one.
Then the stronghold, at half price
Implementations get cheaper because others help
build them. No walls until there is bread to protect.

Andre Comeau, The Bot Procurement Book, CC BY 4.0. The order of building follows the cleric's stronghold rule in the AD&D 1st edition Dungeon Masters Guide (1979). Colours and type follow the Protocol Institute brand kit; not a Protocol Institute figure.
